  "summary": "Prevents discarded output groups from being added to the discarded list twice when `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` is enabled. Discards are now recorded only during the mixed group evaluation pass, which covers all outputs.",
  "problem": "When `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` is used, `GroupOutputs` processes positive-value outputs into both mixed and positive-only maps. Groups failing eligibility checks (such as hitting mempool chain limits) are inserted into `discarded_groups` twice, leading `AutomaticCoinSelection` to subtract their value twice and potentially fail with an unexpected insufficient funds error despite adequate funds.",

    "Functional test `test_too_long_mempool_chain_avoid_partial_spends` reproduces the issue with an `avoid_reuse=True` wallet having a discarded 25-ancestor unconfirmed chain alongside an independent confirmed coin."

result.scope_notes: A one-line logic fix in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` accompanied by a functional regression test in Python.
result.card: Prevents output groups failing eligibility filters from being recorded twice when -avoidpartialspends or avoid_reuse is active. In those modes, output groups were pushed to discarded_groups in both the mixed and positive-only passes, causing AutomaticCoinSelection to double-subtract their value from available funds and spuriously fail with an insufficient funds error. The fix records discards only on the mixed pass and adds a regression test reproducing the failure using a long unconfirmed ancestor chain.
